gain.representatives: Samples at or above target loudness are attenuated; no intentional boost.

velocity_inference.method: rank of maximum 20 ms RMS attack level

audio.channel_policy: Highest-energy source channel selected per hit; silent interface channels discarded.
audio.classification: Measured from runtime WAV channel content.

timing.playback: Align the musical event to playback_offset_seconds. In Web Audio, call source.start(beatTime, playback_offset_seconds).
timing.file_start: WAV files retain pre-attack audio; do not assume sample frame zero is the hit onset.

audition.purpose: Human reference; plays every distinct sample once in samples-array order.
